observation.description: No guide page explains how to evolve a sessions-mode app's schema over existing data. The versioned-seeds page says 'use a migration to evolve durable data' but documents no migration surface; SNAPBACK_AUTH_STARTUP_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH and the startup artifact-pair pin appear nowhere in guide/ (grep verified); the fact that the LIVE watch reload is the only working evolution path — and its live-subscriber caveat (f5) — is discoverable only by experiment. The arm burned its only debugging detour here (~15 minutes and three probe scripts for an additive optional-field evolution, the single most routine operation a growing app performs).

competitorOutcome.description: Convex documents schema evolution as a first-class workflow (schema validation on push, staged migrations); the frozen Linear arm followed documented steps for its production-shaped schema change.

mustNotRegress: The pin and the fail-closed load remain; the docs must teach the honest surface, not soften it.
smallestCoherentFix: A guide page (or a versioned-seeds section) 'Evolving a live app': additive evolution through the running dev loop, the startup artifact-pair pin and its refusal code, the current live-subscriber caveat, and what is NOT yet supported (destructive migrations), with a CI-verified snippet.
acceptanceWitness: A cold agent retrieval eval for 'how do I add a field to a table that already has data (sessions mode)?' lands on the page and the page's snippet runs in CI.
